item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera studies her school garden in Nagpur to find out why plants grow well in some corners but not others. Which statement about how water, sunlight, and moving air help sustain life on Earth is not correct?

options.A: Sunlight warms water, which evaporates, forms clouds, and returns as rain that refills ponds, lakes, and wells.
options.B: Plants use sunlight to make food, so nearly all living beings depend on it for energy.
options.C: Because most of the Earth has water, the same plants and animals can live in every place on Earth.
options.D: Moving air carries water vapour and rain-bearing clouds, so rainfall differs from place to place and decides which plants and animals can live in each region.
